summary: Granite-dome lookout east of Shaver Lake in the Sierra NF: cabin 1905, tower dated 1934 or 1936, lightning in 1921, last staffed 1979, still listed as standing.

facts.design: H-brace metal tower with a cab (register); one account gives a 14 x 14 ft cab on an 18 ft 6 in tower
facts.status_note: Abandoned in October 1979; the Forest Fire Lookout Association's California list still shows it as standing.

visit.trail_note: Off-highway vehicle route to the summit (busy on weekends, per 2008 photo page); without a suitable vehicle, hike the road marked 9S43

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Sierra National Forest (High Sierra Ranger District cooperates)

corrections.why: The register gives a 20 ft tower (about 6.1 m) and California Lookouts gives 18 ft 6 in (about 5.6 m); neither supports 10 m

notes_for_editor: Built year conflicts: the register gives 1934 for a 20 ft tower, California Lookouts gives 1936 for a CCC-built 18 ft 6 in tower; both kept in the story, not resolved. Record height_m 10.0 looks wrong. Nothing after the 2008 photos describes the cab, and no current access notice was found; status 'standing' rests only on the FFLA list. Newspaper quotes come through a hobbyist transcription page, not the originals. Do not confuse with the Inyo NF Bald Mountain Lookout in Mono County (1963 tower), which search results return first.
